_readme: The single source of truth for every market. Edit this, run `node scripts/build-cities.js`, commit the generated <slug>.html files and cities.html. Adding a market is one entry here. Never hand-edit a generated page, the build overwrites it.
_nostatus: There is deliberately no live/coming-soon flag. A market that announces itself as not-open-yet tells a venue owner they would be the first one in, which is the single thing that stops them signing. Every city is presented the same way. What differs is only what we can honestly show: a city with installed screens shows its pins and its counts, a city without them shows its coverage area and its venue types. Never invent a pin or a count for a city that has none.

_coverage: coverage[] drives both the line under the city headline and the coverage map. Each entry is a real place with real coordinates. `radiusKm` draws a circle; omit it to place a label only. ONE big circle round the market centre was tried first and at 11 km it swallowed most of Edmonton, which claims a city we do not sell in. Draw the communities, not a radius.
